senses.gloss:
Much,Ⓒa.Ⓓbahu, bahula, pracura, BUri, vipula, pra-, gAQa, atyaMta, nirBara, mahat, atyarTa, atirikta, utkawa, atimAtra, nitAMta, prAjya, puru, adaBra; gen. ex. by su, ati pr., atiSaya in comp.
Ⓔs.Ⓓbahu n. or in comp., bAhulyaM, bahuBAgaH, BUyizWaM, BUyizWaBAgaH; ‘talking m(uch)’ bahuBAzin; ‘as m(uch) as’ tAvat-yAvat; ‘as m(uch) as may lie in oneʼs power’ yaTA-Sakti, yAvacCakyaM; ‘how m(uch)’ kiyat; ‘so m(uch)’, ‘this m(uch)’ iyat, etAvat; tAvat (as correlative of yAvat); ‘that m(uch)’ tAvat, ‘m(uch) more’, ‘m(uch) less’ kimuta, kimu, kiMpunaH.
Ⓔadv.Ⓓbahu, BfSaM, atyaMtaM, BUri, gAQaM, nirBaraM, nitAMtaM, atimAtraM, su-ni-tarAM, balavat, ati-su- pr.; See Exceedingly.

Mucilage,Ⓒs.Ⓓmedas n., vasA, vapA.
Ⓑ
 2 Slezman m., cikkaRavastu.
ⓃMucilaginous,Ⓒa.ⒹcikkaRa, snigDa.
Ⓑ
 2 Slezmala-Ra.

Muck,Ⓒs.ⒹpurIzaM; See Dung.
Ⓑ
 2 malaM, kardamaH, kalkaM, ameDyaM, kaluzaM; ‘m(uck)-heap, or -hill’ malarASiH-saMcayaH, avakaranikaraH; ‘m(uck)-sweat’ atisvedaH, atyaMtaGarmaH, ‘m(uck)-worm’ paMkajaH, kIwaH.
Ⓔv. t.Ⓓmalena lip 6 P.
Ⓝ[Muck]y,Ⓒa.Ⓓmalina, samala, paMkila, ameDya.

Mucus,Ⓒs.ⒹSlezman m., malaM, iMdriyamalaM; ‘m(ucus) of the nose’ siMGARaM, siMhARaM-naM, nAsA-malaM; ‘m(ucus) of the throat’ kaPaH, SlezmA; ‘m(ucus) of the bowels’ AmaH; ‘m(ucus) of the urethra’ puzpaM, ftuH
ⓃMucous, Muculent,Ⓒa.ⒹcikkaRa; SlezmaRa-la, kaPa-saguRa.
Ⓑ
 2 Slezma-kaPa-kara (rI f.).
